evidence.decision: Verifies one person’s defined Move/Exercise/Stand measures before choosing rings, rejecting team aggregates and unrelated goals.
evidence.artifact: Requires measure/person/pairing and surrounding-clearance contract with standard rendering in a revised artifact.
evidence.transformation: Purple combined-friends challenge rings become an unchanged individually identified Activity element and a separate team visualization.
evidence.verification: Checks crop, black margin, identity and legitimate pairing-history variation; restyling, unrelated measures or decorative reuse fail.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies iOS paired/unpaired one/three-ring history and Mac/TV/visionOS exclusion; health data and native rendering need device evidence.
evidence.handoffs: Workouts supplies session context and Charts handles unrelated/team measures rather than misusing Activity rings.
evidence.distinctiveness: Defined system metrics, one-person identity and immutable rendering distinguish this from an arbitrary circular gauge.
